notes: THE PAGE SAYS WHERE IT IS DURING THE TWO SILENT PASSES. The verify stage now prints 'checked N of 432 chunk(s)' while Whisper listens, every couple of seconds, and the page turns it into the stage's bar and the card's line; the judge's pass over the pool before any fetch ('the judge re-reads the pool before fetching: N of M clips') moves the Clips card and the footage bar as it goes, and it reports every 20 clips instead of 40. A running card shows its live count instead of its last note. Since 1.3.76: the footage starts beside the first stage the Run actually runs.
